youtube.title: The 1859 experiment that explained the sky 🔬 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
In 1859, John Tyndall shone a beam of light through a tube of fine mist and the mist glowed blue from the side. Years later, Lord Rayleigh worked out the maths: tiny particles scatter short waves far more than long ones. So the sky does not reflect the ocean. It is sunlight bouncing off the air itself. Full episode on the channel.
